long_biography.plain_text:
Carlos A. López-Lay joined Bella Group in 1991 to lead Sound Gallery, a new in-car audio and security division. He moved through management, became chief operating officer in 2002 and, two years later, acquired the company with María Isabel Esteve. That transition combined his operating career with ownership of an established Puerto Rican automotive distributor.

As president and chief executive, López-Lay led Bella's expansion beyond Honda and Acura into a wider network of dealerships, vehicle distribution, power equipment and rental operations. The group added Mazda distribution, broadened its Flagship dealer network and acquired additional brands and a daily-rental business. His durable role is therefore both operator and acquirer: he bought into a family-founded company, then reinvested and diversified it across Puerto Rico.
